story.headline: Three steps. That's it.
story.body: No banking partner. No approval queue. No custody. Your buyer pays, we settle on-chain, funds land in the wallet you already own.

step1.title: Someone pays you.
step1.body: Share a link, drop an inline checkout, or hit the API. Your buyer picks from 9 blockchains — BTC, ETH, USDC, USDT, XRP, Tron and more — and pays.

step2.title: We settle it your way.
step2.body: Keep the original coin, or auto-convert to USDT / USDC on any chain. Live market rates, converted automatically once the payment confirms on-chain — no manual steps.

step3.title: It lands in your wallet.
step3.body: Payout goes straight to the wallet address you control — not held by us. 1.5% to start, as low as 0.5% at scale. No monthly fee, no chargebacks.

faq.headline: Frequent questions.
faq.q1: Do I need to hold crypto to accept it?
faq.a1: Nope. Buyers pay in any of our 15 supported coins & tokens across 9 chains, and you decide what you keep — hold the original coin, or auto-convert to USDC or USDT, settled to your wallet as soon as the payment confirms on-chain. You never touch a crypto exchange.
faq.a2: Directly in a wallet address you control — not held by us. Dynopay is non-custodial. Every settlement is a real on-chain transfer to your address.
faq.a3: Every payment costs a simple percentage — from 1.5% (Starter) down to 0.5% (Enterprise), based on your all-time settled volume — and your first payment is fee-free. No monthly fee, no setup fee, no chargebacks. See the Fees page for full pricing details.
faq.a4: It depends on the network. Stablecoin rails and fast chains (TRC-20, Polygon, L2s) usually confirm in a minute or two; Bitcoin and Ethereum mainnet can take longer when they're busy. Your dashboard shows live transaction status the whole way — and if you've turned on auto-convert, funds land in your chosen stablecoin the moment the payment confirms; otherwise you keep the coin the buyer sent.
faq.q5: Do you support fiat, refunds, or subscriptions?
faq.a5: Refunds, yes — one-click, on-chain reversals that send funds straight back to the buyer's address. We don't do fiat cards or auto-recurring subscriptions today: every charge is a direct, one-time crypto payment settled to a wallet you control, with optional auto-convert to USDC or USDT. Need a repeat payment? Just reshare the same link.
faq.a6: Yes. Share your referral link and you'll earn 25% of the Dynopay fees from every merchant you refer, for 12 months — taken as fee credit or cashed out in USDT (TRC-20). Your friend gets 50% off fees for 30 days the moment they join; your revenue share starts once they take their first payment.

pain.headline: Crypto payments shouldn't be this hard
pain.body: Volatile balances, custodial risk, chargeback fraud and bolted-on checkouts hold merchants back. Dynopay removes each one.
pain.p1: Prices swing before you can spend what you earned.
pain.f1: Auto-convert every payment to stablecoin the moment it settles.
pain.p2: A third party holds your funds — and can freeze them.
pain.f2: Non-custodial by design: crypto lands in your own wallet, never ours.
pain.p3: Card chargebacks claw back revenue months later.
pain.f3: On-chain payments are final — zero chargebacks, ever.
pain.p4: Integrations drag on and the checkout feels bolted-on.
pain.f4: A hosted checkout and clean REST API get you live in an afternoon.

why.headline: Built different where it counts
why.body: We don't win on the lowest headline rate — we win on what actually protects your money and your time.
why.c1d: Payments settle straight to your own wallet. We never hold or pool your crypto.
why.c2d: Neutralize volatility automatically the instant a payment confirms.
why.c3t: You choose who pays the fee
why.c3d: Pass the network and processing fee to the customer, or absorb it — your call, per payment.
why.c4d: Refund a customer in the original coin, straight from your dashboard.
why.c5d: Pay only when you get paid — and your very first payment is completely fee-free.
why.c6d: A clean REST API, sandbox keys and webhooks for every payment event. No SDK lock-in.
why.c7d: Run multiple businesses or brands from a single login — each with its own checkout, wallets and settlement. Switch between them in one click.
